notes: Draft configuration: Operator September 2018 event course plan identifies the earlier infield horseshoe and both frontstretch and backstretch chicanes. Exact nodes from the consistent 2020 independent snapshot retain those earlier branches; the later expanded backstretch and 2024 infield extension are excluded. The source frontstretch and backstretch ways are separately named and retain their pinned versions. This is a draft earlier course centreline, with coarse corner alignment and catalogue distance retained separately; travel direction and historical timing correspondence remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3600.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
